Here are Walmart's revenues for its last two fiscal years, as reported in their SEC filings:

| Fiscal Year End | Revenue |
|---|---|
| January 31, 2026 (FY2026) | **$713.16 billion** |
| January 31, 2025 (FY2025) | **$680.99 billion** |

**Key Takeaway:**
Walmart grew its revenue by approximately **$32.2 billion**, a year-over-year increase of roughly **4.7%**, from FY2025 to FY2026.

> 📌 *Note: Walmart's fiscal year ends on January 31, so "FY2026" covers the period ending January 31, 2026. These figures come from Walmart's 10-K filing submitted on March 13, 2026.*
